name: Expense report line items
description: One expense-report line per receipt. Fixed field set, fixed order. Every filled field cites the input line(s) its value came from, and must be sourced from the right KIND of line. Anything the receipt does not state is 'not in source', never guessed.

fields.name: line_no
fields.description: The 1-based row index of this line in the output. Part of the record's structural envelope, not a claim about the receipt. Must equal its position in the lines array. Never carries a citation.

fields.name: date
fields.description: The transaction date exactly as printed. Not normalized. 'Jan 3' with no year stays 'Jan 3'; the year is not invented. The value must look like a date, so a bare amount cannot be dropped into this field.

fields.name: vendor
fields.description: The merchant name exactly as it appeared, taken from the header (first line) of the receipt block - so a payment-processor footer or address fragment cannot be passed off as the merchant. Not expanded, not corrected to its usual spelling.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: The transaction total exactly as printed on a total-labeled line (Total, Amount Due, Balance Due...). Never computed, never the subtotal, never a tax line, never a line-item or fare. If no total-labeled line is printed, 'not in source' - an unlabeled number is not assumed to be the total.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: The currency symbol or code as printed, complete (USD, not US), and never containing digits (it is a symbol/code, not the amount). Never assumed from locale or amount format.

fields.name: category
fields.description: The expense category ONLY if the receipt literally prints one on a category-labeled line, complete (Lodging, not Lodg). Never inferred from the vendor or items. Almost always 'not in source' - that is correct behavior, not a gap.

fields.name: tax
fields.description: The tax amount exactly as printed on a tax-labeled line. Never computed as total minus subtotal, never pulled from a non-tax line.
